ravi: PR #9112 — urgent patch for token routing. Need approvals from runtime and security before midnight PT (23:59) or we have to cut the rollback path. Can folks triage? https://git.internal/redwood/pr/9112 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maya: on it, assigning self as reviewer. quick scan now — pinging @serena for security signoff.

serena: reading. small concern about header propagation in edge case, leaving inline comment. i can approve once tests pass or we add a guard.

liam: CI shows a flaky membench test on the runner, I retriggered the job: `ci retry 3723456789/9112` — queued. deploy-bot will post status.

deploy-bot: Build queued for PR #9112 — job 5567 started :gear: (https://ci.internal/5567)

maya: left a tiny nit and a suggested smoke check. snippet I proposed:
```
# smoke test to validate token routing after hotfix
assert request('/v1/infer', headers={'x-customer-id': 'test'}) == 200
```
I can add this in a follow-up commit if you want, ravi.

ravi: thanks, pushed a small test commit `hotfix/9112-smoke` -> pushed. link: https://git.internal/redwood/commit/aa12bb.

deploy-bot: Job 5567 succeeded :white_check_mark: (all checks passed)

serena: re-reviewed the updated diff, guard looks good. approving now. :white_check_mark:

liam: second approval from runtime, LGTM. :thumbsup:

ravi: great — merging now. if anything flakes in canary, plan is: 1) autobackout canary 2) open follow-up hotfix branch and escalate to oncall. thanks everyone for quick turnaround.

maya: nice, thanks team.

deploy-bot: PR #9112 merged by ravi and deployed to canary environment :rocket:

ravi: marking release blocker cleared. will monitor metrics for 30m then promote.
